ORR

ORR jewellery that moves

Skólavörðustígur 17b, Reykjavík designed and hand made

SILVER, set in MOTION

A stone that sits loose in its bowl and rolls with the hand. Pearls on thin arms that quiver at every step. Silver left to set the way lava sets. Orr’s jewellery is not still, and every piece is designed and hand made at Skólavörðustígur 17b, where the shop and the workshop are the same room.

See the lines

FIVE lines, one MOTION

Each line solves the same problem its own way: how to hold a stone without stopping it.

LausHraunKineticDeliquescentPerla

01 / 05

The stone is never fixed

Laus

Laus is Icelandic for loose, and it means exactly that. The stone sits unfixed in its setting and rolls with every movement of the hand. Fourteen carat gold or sterling silver, quartz, rubies and zircon.

from €87for example: Laus Yellow Gold & Quartz

Silver sets like lava

Hraun

Hraun is Icelandic for lava. Molten silver is left to set with a rough crust around the stone, the way lava sets around rock. Spinel, rubies and zircon in hand made sterling silver.

from €265for example: Silver Hraun Ring with a Blue Spinnel

Pearls quiver on wires

Kinetic

Natural freshwater pearls sit on thin silver arms and quiver with every step. The piece arranges itself anew each time it is worn.

from €224for example: Kinetic Multi Coloured Pearl Earrings

Silver at its melting point

Deliquescent

Ribbons and links with a melted texture, no two the same. The heavy necklace is made of wide links and can be worn doubled.

from €62for example: Deliquescent Silver Ring

Pearls on sprung wire

Perla

Freshwater pearls in white, pink and grey on curved silver wire that springs around the wrist. Irregular baroque pearls keep their own shape.

from €190for example: Perla Mix Braclet

MOLTEN. loose. ALIVE.

Three states of the same metal.

01

molten

The silver gives

The Hraun and Deliquescent lines begin in the crucible. The silver is heated until it runs, and the texture that sets is never the same twice. No two links are alike, and no ring has a twin.

02

loose

The stone is left free

In the Laus line the setting is built around the stone without fixing it. It rolls and turns inside its bowl, and the piece sounds different on every hand.

03

alive

The piece carries itself

The Kinetic and Perla pieces move with the wearer. Pearls on thin arms quiver at every step, and the piece arranges itself anew each time. Quicksilver, in the word’s fullest sense.

  2. 02loose
  3. 03alive

and the silver is alive

THE SHOP is the WORKSHOP

One room at Skólavörðustígur 17b: the bench, the crucible and the counter. What is in the shop was made a few metres from the shelf it stands on.

The facts

  • KÖK + GB

    Design and making

    All Orr jewellery is designed and hand made by Kjartan Örn Kjartansson and Guðbjörg Bárðardóttir. The shop and the workshop are one and the same room at Skólavörðustígur 17b.

  • 2016

    The Njörður shield

    Orr received the Njarðarskjöldur award for 2016, from the City of Reykjavík and the Icelandic Federation of Trade, as tourist shop of the year.

  • 925 / 14K

    The materials

    Sterling silver, 14 carat gold, white gold and platinum. Natural freshwater pearls, spinel, quartz, onyx and rubies. Custom sizes and stones are always available to order.
